body:
New HealthError defenum (BadStatus/NotOk) replaces a bare String ErrorType in interpret-health-response -- BURROW's freshly-shipped defenum support exercised in real code for the first time, not just tests. Host reads .Tag directly (match-on-defenum still unsupported). go test clean, live-verified against IDUNA :8080. PARENA commit 73a78ca, IDUNA_PRO commit fd70451.

⚓ ☃
title: defenum put into real production use in idunapro CLI (card 9988)
